$schema: hand-authored — the one screen input that is not extracted
$why: src/data/screen-map.json is generated wholesale from the React Native app's
navigation source on every run of scripts/build-screen-map.mjs, and it is
gitignored for that reason. Anything hand-written into it survives exactly
until the next sync and then disappears, taking six FpScreen values and a
So screens that have no RN original live here instead, in the repository,
and the generator merges them in. Every entry it merges is stamped
invented: true; every screen it extracts is stamped invented: false. The
RN-derived arithmetic — 36 in scope + 11 retired = the 47-member Screen
enum — is computed before this file is read and is not affected by it.
That is the point: the map stays a faithful extraction of the RN app AND
carries the screens this app adds, with the join visible in one field.
$rules: key must not exist in the RN Screen enum. A collision is an error, not an override.
deepLink is required and must not collide with an RN deep link or another invented one.
navigator must name a navigator the RN app actually has, or be null.
These screens are NOT added to the navigator tree. The tree is a drawing of the RN app's navigation and stays one.

screens.title: SIGN IN
screens.note: Email and password, the route to account creation, and the route to password recovery. The RN app has no such screen: sign-in there is Auth0 Universal Login opened in a system browser against https://auth.fluent.pet/authorize, so there is nothing to port.

screens.title: CREATE ACCOUNT
screens.note: Email and one password field with a reveal toggle and a live requirement list. Leads to VERIFY_EMAIL.

screens.title: RESET PASSWORD
screens.note: One email field. Asks for the reset mail to be sent; leads to CHECK_YOUR_EMAIL.

screens.title: CHECK YOUR EMAIL
screens.note: Confirmation that a reset link was sent, with a rate-limited resend. Never claims the address exists — only the mail server knows that.

screens.title: NEW PASSWORD
screens.note: Where the emailed reset link lands. Takes the address and the link's token as query parameters, so the deep link is the whole entry point.

screens.title: VERIFY EMAIL
screens.note: Where sign-up lands: waiting for the verification link to be opened, and the confirmed state the link returns to.
